lines.en: Wings open and close; I drift upward.
Orange-red wings shine in the light.
I fly along the woodland clearing.
My wings beat fast and very soft.

lines.zh: 我在树叶上方打了个弯。
lines.en: I curve just above the leaves.
The morning wind carries me east.
I loop around the same pine.
My wingtip brushes a wet leaf.
I settle once and take off again.
I don't fly high, but very steady.
I linger on the wetland side.
The dark veins on my wings show clearly.
I fly in the direction of the sun.
My shadow flickers across the ground.
I settle on an orchid.
Then I rise and head into the trees.
I close my wings and rest on a twig.

lines.zh: 橙红的翅面收成一片叶。
lines.en: My orange wings close like a leaf.
I spread my wings flat to warm up.
The sun glows right through my wings.
I have a few more flights to make before dusk.
I'm most lively between dawn and dusk.
Dew dampens the edge of my wings.
Another butterfly is far off.
I flap twice and settle again.
This flower still has nectar.
I hide myself in the leaf shadow.
When the wind moves, I fold tighter.

lines.zh: 你离我的兰花只有一步。
lines.en: You are one step away from my orchid.
I lift my wings to show their underside.
Your nose is right below me.
I've come to rest on your shoulder.
I have landed on your cuff, so hold still.
Your breath blows me off balance.
Are you thinking of catching me?
The red on my wings stands out.
One look at you and I'm off.
Don't slap at me with your palm.
There is a crease pinched into my right wing.
A patch is missing from my wing.
I fall, then rise again.
Some of my scales have rubbed off.
Even something this light can be hurt.
I steady myself, wobbling.
The wind stings as it passes.
I duck beneath a leaf.
I can't fly fast anymore.
My wing base feels weak, so I drop down.
That's not a flower; I won't go.
Is there any nectar in that?
I only settle on orchids.
There's no nectar on your hand.
This one does look rather like a bloom.

lines.zh: 兰花的气味从那边飘来。
lines.en: The scent of orchids drifts over from there.
The color's too bright — suspicious.
I uncurl my proboscis to test it.
No — this one is false.
I fly back to the real flowers.
You brushed against my wing.
Scale dust rubs onto your hand.
The bump flipped me in a circle.
I drop lower before flying on.
Your fingers are blocking my path.
I skim past your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你的网圈擦过我的翅尖。
lines.en: Your net rim grazed my wingtip.
Even something this light can collide.
I hurry upward out of reach.
The wind pushed us both aside.
So you're in this wood as well.
We circle round each other.
We fly wing against wing.
Let's find orchid nectar together.
The red on your wings runs deeper.
We land side by side on a bloom.
This wetland is room enough for us.
Follow me; don't drift apart.
Our eggs will stay on the leaves.
We'll fly together till dusk.
The nectar in this bloom is good.
The nectar is drained, so I coil up my proboscis.
That isn't something I can carry.
I can only carry a little pollen.
Something landed on my wing.
There is scale dust stuck to my feet.
It's caught on my leg.
I let it drop and fly on.
There are eggs on this leaf.
Don't step on that cluster of leaves.
Something's moving — very conspicuous.
I gain height to watch.
That patch of color is not nectar.
I circle up to your eye level.
The net is not closed yet, so I leave first.
I dip down and lift away.
My wings make a very soft sound.
I'm only here to watch.
I skim past your shoulder.
Swatting won't catch me.
I'm on my third circle around you.
I'm just above your head.
Your hand moves far too early.
I land and instantly lift off.
I'm perched on your hat brim.
My wings are barely audible.
Turn your head and I change course.
I fly along the line of your shadow.
I ride the rising air and hover.
No hurry; I'll just drift.
I bump right in front of your eyes.
My wings flutter across your face.
Scale dust falls into your eyes.
You swat again, uselessly.
I slip around from below.
This hardly counts as an attack.
Third pass across your face.
You frown and look at the sky.
I'm only being a nuisance.
I fly off a short way.
I break out of my chrysalis.
My wing membranes are still soft.
I dry my wings on a leaf.
The orange spreads out bit by bit.
Morning light falls at the forest's edge.
I flap my wings for the first time.
I take off, wobbling.
Flower scent comes from the wetland.
Dew still beads on the leaves.
Another butterfly is close by.

lines.zh: 热气把我的翅膀烤卷了。
lines.en: The heat has curled my wings.
I've dropped from a height.
Water has gummed my wings together.

lines.zh: 爆炸的冲击吹散了我的鳞粉。
lines.en: The blast blew the scales right off my wings.
A fine pin has gone through my wing vein.

lines.zh: 那阵光让我的翅发白发冷。
lines.en: That light leaves my wings pale and cold.
Hunger has grounded me.
The thunderclap knocks me downward.
No flowers below, and no wind.
